exposure: application of a balloon catheter in the morning
application of a balloon catheter in the evening
timing of balloon catheter placement (morning vs evening)
cohort: 415 women with an unfavorable cervix undergoing labor induction at term
finding: While cesarean section rates did not differ, placing a balloon catheter in the evening resulted in fewer failed inductions in nulliparous women and a shorter induction-to-delivery interval with more deliveries within 24 hours in parous women.
